# Changelog v0.20.1

Release Date: 2026-09-24

## 🔌 API

- Expose llama.cpp placement, MoE, fit and image token load config fields. (see PR [#4412](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4412)) - See [API changes](./api.md)
- Answer assessModelFit from the engine fitter, not only from coefficients. (see PR [#4535](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4535)) - See [API changes](./api.md)

## 🧹 Chores

- Move the engine to @qvac/registry-client 0.7.0. (see PR [#4582](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/4582))
